subject: Post-demo: Draft MAP & stakeholder RACI for DataWave
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@datawave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:22:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap & draft MAP (first pass)

Samantha — thanks again for your time today. Attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan we sketched during the demo. Summary of the call below and a few asks to keep momentum: 

Key outcomes from demo:
- DataWave likes the low-latency routing and prefix-caching example for streaming metrics.
- Security wants to validate audit-log retention and role mapping before a Prod greenlight.
- Procurement indicated a procurement window by end-November, but legal will likely need a week for T&Cs.

Draft MAP highlights (attached DW-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx):
1) Trial phase (PoC) — target start: 12/01, duration 4 weeks — Redwood provides sandbox cluster + 100k tokens/day. Owner: DataWave Eng (T. Whitaker) / Redwood CSM (Marissa).
2) Security review — deliverables: SOC2 evidence set + audit log sample. Owner: DataWave Security (S. Lee) / Redwood SecOps (Ben). Dependency: NDAs/SC access.
3) Commercial & legal — target close: 2027-01-07. Owner: DataWave Legal (T. Whitaker) / Redwood Sales (Karthik).
4) Production rollout — dependency on quantization/perf baseline and VPC config. Owner: DataWave Eng / Redwood Eng Ops.

Asks / next steps:
- Samantha: can you confirm the economic buyer (name + email) and the security owner we should loop in for evidence requests?
- Tom: please confirm the engineering lead who will own PoC infra (name + calendar availability for a short kickoff next week).
- Marissa / Ben: can you review the MAP and confirm the RACI (we tried to map roles on the second tab) and update any missing internal owners?

I propose a quick 30-min kickoff next Wednesday (11/25) to lock the PoC timeline and sign off on the MAP. If that works for your team I can send a calendar invite.

Attachments: DW-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: milestones, owners, target dates), network-security-summary.pdf (sec evidence checklist stub)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@datawave.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@datawave.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T21:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & draft MAP (first pass)

Thanks Karthik — good summary and I appreciate the fast turnaround. Quick answers inline:

- Economic buyer: our CFO, Priya Raman (priya.raman@datawave.ai) — she signs off on contracts >$50k.
- Security owner for evidence collection: that will be me for now; Tom will be the engineering contact for PoC infra.
- Legal contact: Tom will handle initial review but procurement/legal may loop in our outside counsel if we blanket redline.

Kickoff: 11/25 works for a 30-min slot in the morning (US-PST). If you can propose 9:00 or 10:00 PST that would be ideal.

A couple of notes on the MAP spreadsheet:
- Please add Priya under the commercial approvals row and mark her as Economic Buyer.
- For security evidence, we will need an example audit log (anonymized) and an architecture diagram for the VPC peering flow.

I'll loop Priya if we get to commercial thresholds, but for now leave her as 'to be engaged' until we have a rough cost estimate.

Best,
Samantha
Head of IT Security | DataWave Analytics
samantha@datawave.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@datawave.ai>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@datawave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & draft MAP (first pass) — RACI suggestions

Looping in a quick internal readout from our side after reviewing DW-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx. I updated the RACI tab with suggested owners and added short notes on dependencies. High-level items below and one request for Karthik to confirm the close window with Priya.

Proposed RACI highlights (internal owners listed):
- Economic Buyer: Priya Raman (external) — Account Executive to engage for pricing/discounts (Karthik).
- Security Owner: Samantha Lee (external) — Redwood SecOps (Ben Carter) will act as Redwood point for evidence collection.
- Legal Owner: DataWave Legal (Tom Whitaker) / Redwood Legal (Marissa) for contract redlines.
- Engineering Lead (PoC): Tom Whitaker (external) — Redwood Eng Ops (Ben) to coordinate VPC/ops tasks.

Additional notes:
- I've marked the PoC start as tentative 2026-12-01 but flagged two blockers: (a) signed SOW (procurement); (b) access for security to sandbox audit logs.
- For the commercial timeline, the 2027-01-07 target close is realistic if Priya can be engaged by mid-December. Recommend we propose a brief pricing deck + one-pager to Priya when we loop her in.

Action items assigned:
- Karthik: confirm a 11/25 kickoff time and reach out to Priya with a short pricing outline (deadline: 11/24 EOD).
- Ben: prepare the SOC2 evidence zip stub and anonymized audit log sample (deadline: 11/24).
- Me (Marissa): update MAP with final RACI after Priya confirmation and own the calendar invite.

Let me know if you want me to pre-draft the one-pager for Priya — I can send a short version for review today.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@datawave.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo — evidence & kickoff prep

Samantha / Karthik — attaching the evidence stubs I mentioned. Contents: network-security-summary.pdf (high-level checklist) and audit-log-sample-anon.log (anonymized, see stub). These are placeholders until we get explicit access to a sandbox export from DataWave.

Quick checklist from my side:
- I will package a SOC2 evidence zip (S3 link) by 11/24.
- Need Samantha to confirm which logs/time window are acceptable (7 vs 30 days).
- For onboarding, Redwood will provide a short runbook for VPC peering and a preflight checklist for the PoC.

Attachments (referenced): DW-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, network-security-summary.pdf, audit-log-sample-anon.log

If everybody's good, Marissa — please go ahead and send the 11/25 10:00 PST invite and I'll join to walk through the evidence expectations.

Thanks,
Ben
Security & Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
